source: A 20-foot-radius sphere of crushing force implodes at a point you choose. Each creature there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d10 force damage and being pulled to the centre on a failure, or half damage and no movement on a success.
Guardian of Nature

You take one of two forms. Primal Beast gives you a 10-foot speed bonus, darkvision to 120 feet, natural claws dealing an extra 1d6 force damage on a hit, and advantage on Strength checks and saves. Great Tree gives you 10 temporary hit points, advantage on Constitution saves, advantage on Dexterity and Wisdom-based attacks, and difficult terrain for enemies within 15 feet.
Psychic Lance

You unleash a spear of psychic energy at one creature you can see, or speak a name and strike whoever bears it within range even unseen. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 7d6 psychic damage on a failure and being incapacitated until the end of your next turn, or half damage on a success.
Shadow of Moil

Guttering shadows wrap you and swallow the light nearby. Radiant damage against you is halved, attackers roll against you with disadvantage, and any creature landing a melee attack on you takes 2d8 necrotic damage in return.
Sickening Radiance

Dim green light fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centred on a point you choose within range. A creature that enters the sphere or starts its turn there must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 radiant damage, gain a level of exhaustion, and shed dim light for the duration, unable to hide.
Staggering Smite

The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack while this spell is active, the attack deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage. The target must then succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and be unable to take reactions until the end of its next turn.
Storm Sphere

A 20-foot-radius sphere of crackling storm appears at a point you choose. It is difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn there takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed Strength saving throw. As a bonus action you can call a lightning bolt at one creature within 60 feet of the sphere for 4d6 lightning damage, halved on a successful Dexterity save.
Summon Aberration

You call an aberrant spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within range. You choose a beholderkin, slaad or star spawn form, and it acts on your turn, obeying your verbal commands. Its attack bonus and save DC match your own spellcasting numbers, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
Summon Construct

You call a construct spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within range. You choose a clay, metal or stone body, and it acts on your turn, obeying your verbal commands. Its attack bonus and save DC match your own spellcasting numbers, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
Summon Elemental

You call an elemental spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within range. You choose air, earth, fire or water, and it acts on your turn, obeying your verbal commands. Its attack bonus and save DC match your own spellcasting numbers, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
Summon Greater Demon

You summon a demon of challenge rating 5 or lower. It obeys your commands while you concentrate, but it makes a Charisma saving throw at the end of each of your turns and breaks free on a success, attacking you before vanishing.
Watery Sphere

A 5-foot-radius sphere of water appears at a point you choose. Creatures in its space must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained inside it, and as a bonus action you can move the sphere up to 30 feet, carrying anything it holds.
Banishing Smite

The next time you hit with a weapon attack while this spell is active, the attack deals an extra 5d10 force damage. If that leaves the target with 50 hit points or fewer, it is banished: a native of another plane is sent home permanently, and any other creature is held in harmless limbo until the spell ends.
Circle of Power

Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura that moves with you. Friendly creatures in it, including you, have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and a creature that succeeds on a save for half damage takes no damage instead.
Conjure Volley

You fire a piece of ammunition or throw a weapon at a point within range and a volley of identical weapons rains down. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 damage of the weapon's type on a failure and half as much on a success.
Control Winds

You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube within range, choosing gusts, a downdraft or an updraft. Gusts impose difficult terrain and disadvantage on ranged attacks against the wind, a downdraft knocks flying creatures down, and an updraft slows falls and lengthens jumps.
Danse Macabre

Dark filaments spear up to five Small or Medium corpses within range and haul them upright as skeletons or zombies under your command. They act on your turn, add your spellcasting ability modifier to attack and damage rolls, and collapse when the spell ends.
Dawn

Sunlight fills a 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder centred on a point within range. A creature that enters the cylinder or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failure and half as much on a success. You can move the cylinder 60 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
